GameSWF / tu-testbed official Subversion revision 1714.

Primary source: https://svn.code.sf.net/p/tu-testbed/code/!svn/bc/1714/trunk/tu-testbed/
Maintainer: https://tulrich.com/geekstuff/gameswf.html

The maintainer describes GameSWF as public domain. Individual source headers state:
"This source code has been donated to the Public Domain. Do whatever you want with it."
Existing per-file credits and notices are retained. This is a pinned native source reuse,
not a claim that revision 1714 is the exact Gameloft fork or that its ActionScript,
input, text, geometry or renderer behavior all matches Dungeon Hunter 2.

The complete fetched-source hashes, portability edits, game adapter edits and final
vendor hashes are retained in ../../reference/gameswf-core/. The game adapter adds
the original export-loader bitmap substitution service. Engine GPU, localization,
font provider, asset ownership and custom ActionScript context bindings remain
explicit host services.
